item.title: When the harness knows better than the model, until it doesn't
item.description: A date guard I wrote for weak models was right for the case it was built for, then silently overruled a correct model on a harder one.

item.title: The tip of the iceberg: evals in the age of self-improving loops
item.description: Self-improving loops used to have a human reviewing the results. Now an automated score decides what is kept, and an eval is only a slice of everything a system could be asked, so user feedback has to stay in the loop.

item.title: Don't trust the LLM to do math: a placeholder pattern for production RAG
item.description: For any value the pipeline can compute from authoritative data, the model should emit a slot, not a literal, and the pipeline should fill the slot before the user sees the response.
